model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигура 4 илюстрира промените в средната абсолютна стойност на стойностите на SDPA преди и след процеса на gating, като се сравняват базовата и по-гатинг версия. Графиката показва две линии, които се движат по оста X, обозначена като "Layer" (Слой), която е линейна и показва стойности от 0 до 20 с интервали от 5. Оста Y, обозначена като "Mean absolute value" (Средна абсолютна стойност), е с линейна скала, която показва стойности от 0 до 1. Първата линия, изобразена с тънка синя линия, започва от стойност близо до 0 при слой 0 и се увеличава постепенно до стойност около 0.1 при слой 20. Втората линия, изобразена с тънка зелена линия, започва от стойност близо до 0 при слой 0 и се увеличава по-бързо, достигайки стойност около 0.1 при слой 20. Двете линии са почти паралелни и имат сходна тенденция, като се вижда, че средната абсолютна стойност на стойностите на SDPA се увеличава с увеличаване на броя на слоевете, а разликата между двете линии е сравнително малка, особено при по-високи слоеве.
model_annotations.Chinese:
Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of the SDPA output before and after gating, with the baseline and post-gating values shown to be similar. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20 in linear increments of 5, with the label "Layer". The y-axis represents the mean absolute value, ranging from 0 to 1 in linear increments of 0.2. Two lines are plotted: a green line with circle markers representing the mean absolute value before gating, which remains consistently close to 0 across all layers; and a blue line with triangle markers representing the mean absolute value after gating, which starts near 0, increases slightly, and then rises sharply to a peak value of approximately 0.9 at layer 20.

Figure 5 shows the proportion of SDPA output values below a specified threshold after gating, with two separate plots for different thresholds. The left plot, labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2", has an x-axis labeled "Layer" ranging from 0 to 20 in linear increments of 5, and a y-axis labeled "Sparsity Ratio" ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear increments of 0.2. It includes three lines: a green line with circle markers for "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", which starts at approximately 0.95 and decreases to about 0.5 at layer 20; a blue line with triangle markers for "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", which starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases to about 0.3 at layer 20; and a red line with square markers for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.13", which starts at approximately 0.9 and decreases to about 0.4 at layer 20. The right plot, labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3", has the same x-axis and y-axis labels and scales. It includes three lines: a green line with circle markers for "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003", which starts at approximately 0.99 and decreases to about 0.9 at layer 20; a blue line with triangle markers for "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126", which starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases to about 0.3 at layer 20; and a red line with square markers for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080", which starts at approximately 0.9 and decreases to about 0.4 at layer 20.
model_annotations.English:
Figure 4: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

Figure 5: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.
model_annotations.German:
Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating, with the baseline and post-gating values appearing similar. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5, and is labeled "Layer". The y-axis represents the mean absolute value, ranging from 0 to 1 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, and is labeled "Mean absolute value". There are two lines: a green dashed line representing the mean absolute value before gating, which remains nearly constant at approximately 0.02 across all layers; and a blue solid line representing the mean absolute value after gating, which starts at approximately 0.02 at layer 0, increases gradually to about 0.04 at layer 20, and shows a slight upward trend with a peak near layer 20.

Figure 5 presents the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold after gating, with two subplots. The left subplot, labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2", shows the sparsity ratio on the y-axis, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, and the x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5. It includes three lines: a green dashed line for the sparsity ratio before gating, which starts at approximately 0.98 at layer 0 and decreases to about 0.85 at layer 20; a blue solid line for the sparsity ratio after gating, which begins at approximately 0.98 and decreases to about 0.44 at layer 20; and a red dotted line for the sparsity ratio after average gating, which starts at approximately 0.98 and decreases to about 0.13 at layer 20. The right subplot, labeled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3", shows the sparsity ratio on the y-axis, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, and the x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5. It includes three lines: a green dashed line for the sparsity ratio before gating, which starts at approximately 0.98 at layer 0 and decreases to about 0.78 at layer 20; a blue solid line for the sparsity ratio after gating, which begins at approximately 0.98 and decreases to about 0.26 at layer 20; and a red dotted line for the sparsity ratio after average gating, which starts at approximately 0.98 and decreases to about 0.08 at layer 20.
